Title: Confidential legal case data exposed via public CPT queries
Mitigation_Strategy: Hardened CPT case to private (publicly_queryable=false exclude_from_search=true show_in_rest=false) and separated public case_study

Title: REST nonce accepted as authorization to access confidential records
Mitigation_Strategy: Enforced is_user_logged_in and per-object ownership validation in check_case_access_permission

Title: REST options save allowed with nonce only without capability
Unconditional front-page loading of heavy monolithic React SPA
Mitigation_Strategy: Conditioned React asset enqueue on explicit shortcodes or authorized admin preview

Title: Hardcoded RTL text direction breaks English/LTR locales
Mitigation_Strategy: Replaced static dir with dynamic is_rtl() ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'

Title: Unbounded query parameters for header/footer style preview
Mitigation_Strategy: Implemented strict archetype allowlist capability check and automatic noindex header

Title: Mismatched build manifest paths in react-shortcodes.php vs functions.php
Mitigation_Strategy: Unified build manifest detection to prioritize canonical app-dist/index.js

Title: DDoS and brute-force attacks on REST endpoints
Mitigation_Strategy: Deployed SedRazavi_Rate_Limiter with IP-based transient tracking and 429 status response

Title: External CDN outages or blocking of Google Fonts / FontAwesome
Mitigation_Strategy: Zero-CDN architecture implemented with 100% self-hosted Vazirmatn and inline SVGs

Title: Flexbox/Grid container collision in Elementor 3.x
Mitigation_Strategy: Implemented responsive container queries and scoped CSS namespace to prevent overflow
